name: Auditable Indexing-State Reconciliation
summary: Reconcile sitemap coverage, Google URL Inspection classifications, public crawlability and daily deltas without treating submission or HTTP success as indexing.
problem: A site may serve healthy URLs while Google reports them unknown or discovered but not indexed, and a fragile coverage-label parser can silently misstate progress.
coreOutcomes: Indexed/discovered/unknown/error counts reconciled against exact URLs
Unicode-safe classification of provider coverage labels
Immutable date-scoped observations and meaningful-change decisions
Sitemap, public crawl and provider indexing independently evidenced
requirements: Authorised official Google Search Console property access for indexed-version reads
An exact same-origin sitemap and known public URL list
A privacy-safe location for provider observations
Bounded API quota and a previous completed observation when comparing changes
boundaries: Inspection is not a request to index and sitemap success does not ensure indexing
User-agent spoofing does not establish real Googlebot admission
Never treat API errors as unknown or not indexed
Do not publish private search queries, credentials or unreviewed raw inspection data
Do not repeatedly resubmit unchanged URLs to force an outcome
